correction_nature: SCORING IMPLEMENTATION CORRECTION of the frozen formal execution — NOT a new experiment, NOT a new benchmark, NOT result re-selection, NOT a protocol amendment. The 10 formal GLM-5.3 runs, oracle, candidate universe, GT mapping, prompt, tool schema and FORMAL_RUN_BUNDLE are unchanged; only the attempt-timeline reconstruction used by the scorer was corrected.
root_cause: v1.0 scorer rebuilt the 300-charged-attempt timeline from tool_calls.jsonl; FormalRunHarness.dispatch() returned INVALID_PRECOMMITMENT before the tool-call logger, so 43 charged attempts (8 runs) were missing from that log and the scored timeline was silently compressed (hits shifted earlier = optimistic bias).

authoritative_timeline_definition.hit_rule: only a VALID successful silencing of a GT member can be a hit; INVALID_PRECOMMITMENT occupies a slot but never a hit
